name: WEB-001 - Host Workspace Shell & Upcoming Meetings View
Description:
Build page shell for Host Workspace featuring upcoming scheduled meetings, instant meeting triggers, and invite link copier. Expectation: Responsive layout allowing hosts to manage sessions easily.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays list of upcoming meetings with Title, Date, Time, Duration, and Host controls
- 'Start Meeting' button launches live room route with host entitlements
- 'Copy Invite Link' button copies clean room URL (/join/{roomId}) to clipboard
- Filter tabs for 'Upcoming', 'Past Sessions', and 'Replays'

name: WEB-002 - Meeting & Webinar Scheduler Modal Component
Description:
Build modal for scheduling new meetings or webinars with date/time selectors, recurring meeting options, and passcode settings. Expectation: Submits schedule payload to Kay's API.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Form inputs for Title, Description, Start Date, Time, Duration, and Timezone
- Toggle for 'Require Waiting Room' and 'Require Passcode'
- Option for Recurring Session (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
- Form validation preventing past date selection and emitting API schedule payload

name: WEB-003 - Paid Event & Ticket Pricing Setup Component
Description:
Build scheduling form extension for Paid Events allowing hosts to set ticket price, currency, and maximum attendee capacity. Expectation: Formats paid event metadata for Odoo and PayGate Shield integration.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Toggle for 'Paid Webinar Event'
- Input fields for Ticket Price, Currency selection (USD, NGN, KES), and Max Capacity
- Configures instant replay access entitlement option for ticket buyers
- Submits paid event configuration to backend API

name: WEB-004 - Replay Publishing & Media Manager UI
Description:
Build media manager view in Host Workspace displaying recorded sessions with visibility controls (Public, Private, Paid Replay). Expectation: Host can set pricing or publish replay links.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Table listing recorded sessions with thumbnail, duration, file size, and creation date
- Visibility dropdown: 'Private', 'Public Free', 'Paid Replay'
- Price input field enabled when 'Paid Replay' is selected
- 'Publish Replay' toggle button updating backend state dynamically

name: WEB-005 - Pre-Meeting Lobby Device Permission & Selector
Description:
Build pre-meeting lobby screen checking camera/mic browser permissions and rendering hardware dropdown selectors. Expectation: Users can test devices before joining room.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Prompts browser media permission request if not granted
- Dropdown selector for Video Cameras with live self-view preview box
- Dropdown selector for Microphones and Audio Output Speakers
- Remember device selection in local storage for returning users

name: WEB-006 - Pre-Meeting Audio Input Level Meter & Test Component
Description:
Build visual audio level meter component in pre-meeting lobby showing live microphone volume input. Expectation: Green audio bar bounces when user speaks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Real-time Web Audio API analyzer measuring mic input volume
- Dynamic green/amber/red audio volume bar component
- 'Test Speaker' button playing sample audio chime to verify output device
- Mute/Unmute microphone toggle button in lobby view

name: WEB-007 - Waiting Room Admission Screen Component
Description:
Build waiting room UI displayed to participants when host has enabled waiting room. Expectation: Displays branded waiting animation until host admits user.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders clean, branded waiting screen displaying Meeting Title and Host Name
- Displays animated 'Waiting for Host to Admit You' loader
- Listens to WebSocket event from host (ADMIT_USER) to automatically transition participant into live room
- 'Leave Waiting Room' button returning user to home page

name: WEB-008 - Live Room WebRTC Canvas Layout Switcher (Grid vs Speaker)
Description:
Build dynamic video canvas switcher supporting Grid View (2x2, 3x3 tiles) and Active Speaker View. Expectation: Smooth layout transitions without video flickering.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Grid View rendering participant video tiles with active speaker green border highlight
- Active Speaker View rendering large main speaker box with horizontal filmstrip of attendees
- Responsive layout adjustment based on active participant count
- Seamless WebRTC <video> stream binding to DOM elements

name: WEB-009 - Screen Share Canvas & Floating Speaker Overlay Component
Description:
Build presenter screen share view rendering shared display stream in large stage canvas with floating speaker video overlay. Expectation: High-resolution screen rendering.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Full-width screen share display stage with zoom controls
- Draggable floating video overlay window for active speaker camera
- 'Stop Sharing' floating control bar for presenter
- Automatically switches all room participants to Screen Share layout when signal received

name: WEB-010 - Meeting Room Bottom Control Bar Component
Description:
Build main in-meeting control bar with essential action buttons. Expectation: Fixed bottom bar with auto-hide capability in full screen mode.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Control buttons: Mute/Unmute Mic, Video On/Off, Screen Share, Raise Hand, Reactions, Chat, Participants, Security, Leave
- Mute and Video buttons reflect current hardware state accurately
- 'Leave Meeting' button opens confirmation modal ('Leave' vs 'End Meeting for All' if host)
- Tooltip labels displayed on hover for all control buttons

name: WEB-011 - In-Meeting Chat Drawer (Public & Host Private Chat)
Description:
Build side-drawer for live text chat supporting Public Room Chat and Private Messages to Host. Expectation: Real-time text display with timestamp and sender badge.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Side-drawer toggles cleanly without obscuring main video canvas
- Tab 1: 'Everyone' (Public Chat room)
- Tab 2: 'Host Only' (Private messages to session host/co-hosts)
- Auto-scroll to latest message with unread message badge on bottom bar

name: WEB-012 - Participant List & Moderation Actions Drawer Component
Description:
Build participant list drawer showing all connected attendees and host moderation tools. Expectation: Host can mute participants or lower hands.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Searchable list of connected participants with audio/video/hand-raised indicators
- Host Controls: 'Mute All', 'Lower All Hands', 'Lock Room'
- Individual Participant Actions dropdown: 'Mute Participant', 'Lower Hand', 'Make Co-Host', 'Remove from Room'
- Real-time list updates when participants join or leave

name: WEB-013 - Webinar Q&A Submission & Upvoting Panel UI
Description:
Build Q&A module drawer for webinar sessions allowing attendees to submit text questions and upvote questions from others. Expectation: Organized Q&A list.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Attendees can submit text questions with option to post anonymously
- Attendees can click 'Upvote' button on open questions
- Host view shows 'Open Questions' (sorted by votes) and 'Answered Questions'
- Host can click 'Answer Live' or type text response

name: WEB-014 - Presenter Elevation Action Modal & Host Controls
Description:
Build modal allowing webinar host to promote a view-only attendee to a live Presenter. Expectation: Prompts attendee for consent before enabling camera/mic.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Host selects 'Promote to Presenter' from participant list
- Sends WebSocket invitation to target attendee ('Host invites you to become a Presenter')
- Upon attendee acceptance, WebRTC media stream renegotiates to enable audio/video publishing
- Host can demote Presenter back to view-only Attendee

name: WEB-015 - In-Meeting TrustLock Shield & E2EE Security Status Badge
Description:
Build top-bar security indicators showing TrustLock status badge, E2EE encryption status, and Active Recording indicators. Expectation: Clear privacy and security visibility.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Red pulsing 'REC' badge displayed when session recording is active
- TrustLock shield icon indicating active security policy profile
- 'E2EE Active' indicator showing encrypted session status
- Tooltip on shield icon displaying session security parameters

name: WEB-016 - Interactive Replay Video Player Component
Description:
Build custom HTML5 video player component for watching recorded sessions and replays. Expectation: Smooth playback with custom controls and chapter markers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Custom video controls: Play/Pause, Timeline Scrubber, Volume, Playback Speed (0.75x to 2x), Fullscreen
- Chapter markers rendered on timeline scrubber matching AI summary takeaways
- Responsive video container supporting 16:9 aspect ratio
- Buffer progress indicator and error handling for expired stream URLs

name: WEB-017 - AI Summary Chapter Index & Timestamp Jump Component
Description:
Build AI Summary panel alongside replay video player displaying key takeaways with clickable timestamp links. Expectation: Clicking timestamp jumps video playback.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays AI Summary overview, key points, and action items
- Each key takeaway includes clickable timestamp link (e.g. '04:15 - Product Architecture')
- Clicking timestamp jumps video player playback head directly to 04:15
- Highlights current active chapter based on current video playback position

name: WEB-018 - Synchronized Interactive Transcript Sidebar Component
Description:
Build transcript sidebar displaying full meeting transcript synchronized with video playback. Expectation: Text auto-scrolls to follow video speaker.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Search input to filter transcript by keyword
- Displays speaker name, avatar, timestamp, and spoken text
- Auto-scrolls transcript box to keep current video playback position highlighted
- Clicking any transcript sentence jumps video playback to that exact timestamp

name: WEB-019 - PayGate Shield Ticket Purchase Checkout Modal Component
Description:
Build checkout modal rendered when attempting to watch a paid webinar or paid replay without entitlement. Expectation: Handles payment gateway checkout redirect.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Displays Event/Replay Title, Host Name, and Ticket Price
- Paystack / Stripe payment selection options
- Submits checkout intent to backend and launches secure payment gateway modal
- Upon payment confirmation webhook, unlocks replay video player immediately without page refresh

name: WEB-020 - Low-Bandwidth Mode & Network Quality Toast Indicators
Description:
Build network quality monitoring indicator rendering warning toast when participant connection degrades. Expectation: Option to switch to Audio-Only low bandwidth mode.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to WebRTC connection state changes (High packet loss / Latency spikes)
- Displays warning toast: 'Poor Network Connection Detected'
- Provides 'Switch to Audio-Only Mode' button (disables incoming video streams to save data)
- Restores video streams automatically or on user toggle when network recovers

name: WEB-021 - TrustLock Dynamic Video Watermarking Overlay Component
Description:
Build dynamic semi-transparent watermark overlay component rendered on participant video tiles (Volume 10). Expectation: Displays viewing user's email and IP address to deter leaks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Renders semi-transparent, floating text overlay across WebRTC video canvas
- Displays viewing participant's email address and masked IP address
- Watermark position periodically shifts slightly (jitter) to prevent static cropping
- Controlled by host security toggle or room TrustLock policy setting

name: WEB-022 - TrustLock Verified Participant Identity Badges
Description:
Build visual identity verification badges displayed on participant tiles in grid and participant list. Expectation: Distinguishes authenticated enterprise users from unverified guest joins.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Green verified checkmark badge rendered next to authenticated enterprise user names
- Amber 'Guest' badge rendered next to unauthenticated join users
- Tooltip on badge displaying verification issuer (e.g. 'Verified by Konn3ct Enterprise SSO')
- Filter in participant list for 'Verified Members Only'

name: WEB-023 - TrustLock Host Room Security Control Panel Modal
Description:
Build dedicated Host Security Control Panel modal accessible from the bottom bar control bar (Volume 10). Expectation: One-stop security controls for session host.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Host Security modal options: 'Lock Room' (block new joins), 'Enable Dynamic Watermarking', 'Disable Screen Share for Participants', 'Disable Chat', 'Mute All on Entry'
- Toggles execute immediate state changes via Redis pub-sub WebSocket events
- Visual status indicators showing active room security enforcement
- Confirmation toast notification displayed upon security parameter updates

name: WEB-024 - TrustLock Anti-Leak Screen Share Protection Overlay
Description:
Build anti-leak screen share protection overlay component applying protective CSS blur when window loses focus during sensitive presentations. Expectation: Prevents casual background recording.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Listens to browser `visibilitychange` and `blur` window events
- When presenter flags presentation as 'Confidential Screen Share', applies protective blur overlay if user switches tabs
- Renders notice: 'Screen Share Paused Due to TrustLock Privacy Policy'
- Automatically restores clear view when window regains active focus
